scraper.code:
function listPosts({url,$}) {return {posts:$('main > details > article.tr-body > details > summary h1 a.link-self').map((_,e)=>({url:$(e).attr('href'),title:$(e).parent().text().trim(),publishedAt:$(e).closest('summary').find('.metadata > span').first().text()})).get(),next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const body=$("main > details > article.tr-body").first().clone();body.find("script,style,nav,header,footer,.upvote,.embedded.blog-posts").remove();return {title:$("main > details > summary h1").first().text().trim(),bodyHtml:body.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||null,publishedAt:$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 實際 /posts/ 列表為最外層 details/article 內各篇 details/summary，僅取直屬文章；單篇正文 main > details > article.tr-body。RSS 5.2MB 超過沙箱輸入限制，改讀較小的公開文章列表。
